items.source:
Hungry for something beyond the usual? Soleat — “Solo eats” / “So let’s eat” — helps you explore Singapore’s {cuisines} cuisine melting pot — and other cities — with {cuisine-venues} curated venues, hawkers, Michelin Star picks, Bib Gourmand favourites under S$45, weather, and transport in one Telegram guide. Start with /c /cuisine or /m /menu

/cuisine   — full Cuisine Picker (over {cuisines} cuisines, {cuisine-venues} curated venues, SG, Johor Bahru + other cities, 6 quick filters)
/hawker    — >{hawker} hawker centres (2025)
/recognised — Michelin, Bib Gourmand, Asia 50/100, Local Produce to Table
/l /location — share or set your current location
/weather   — now + 2-hour NEA forecast
/transport — bus, MRT, walk, drive
/carpark   — nearest 5 with available lots
/language  — app language · 8 options (chat stays EN/FR)
/privacy   — data, retention & sources
/legal     — disclaimer & jurisdiction notes
/forgetme  — erase your stored data

Or tap the menu button (🍴 Cuisine Picker) to jump straight in.
items.context: First-run greeting. Repo note: /start intro body — v0.60.67: leading paragraph replaced per Human Lead 2026-05-10. Drops the legacy "I'm Gia" framing in favour of a Soleat pitch that names the catalogue depth (50+ cuisines, hawkers, Michelin, Bib Gourmand, weather, transport) and closes with /c · /cuisine · /m · /menu CTA. /hidden, /ver, and /sha… "Pick" is a chosen venue, not a tool or an act of picking. Placeholders {cuisines} {cuisines} {hawker} are substituted at send time and must survive unchanged.
items.google_translation: 想尝试一些与众不同的美食吗？Soleat — “Solo eats” / “So let's eat” — 帮助你探索新加坡的{cuisines}美食大熔炉，以及其他城市，在一个Telegram指南中，你可以看到{cuisine-venues}精心挑选的餐厅、小贩摊位、米其林星级餐厅、45新元以下的必比登推介餐厅、天气和交通信息。首先输入/c /cuisine或/m /menu /cuisine — 完整的美食选择器（涵盖{cuisines}种美食、{cuisine-venues} 个精选餐厅、新加坡、新山及其他城市，以及 6 个快速筛选器） /hawker — > {hawker}个小贩中心（2025 年） /recognised — 米其林、必比登推介、亚洲 50/100 强、本地食材直送餐桌/l /location — 分享或设置您的当前位置/weather — 当前天气 + 2 小时 NEA 天气预报/transport — 巴士、地铁、步行、驾车/carpark — 附近 5 个有空位的停车场/language — 应用语言 · 8 种选项（聊天语言为 EN/FR） /privacy — 数据、保留和来源/legal — 免责声明和管辖权说明/forgetme — 删除您存储的数据 或点击菜单按钮（🍴 美食选择器）直接进入。
